name: comp-266
title: Audio Equalizer Slider
blurb: Array of vertical sliders styled as an audio equalizer.
description: Multiple vertical sliders arranged in a row, each controlling a frequency band or level, styled like an audio EQ.
avoid_when: When the audio metaphor does not apply.
a11y: Multiple sliders require clear labeling for each band. Keyboard nav between sliders needs clear focus.
